    BatteryLogger
    Tracks and logs current draw, power, and cumulative energy consumption across subsystems each robot loop cycle.

    Automatically generated file containing build version information.

    Caches a DoubleSupplier value so it is computed at most once per scheduler iteration.

    The CAN buses FM runs on under SystemCore, and the one place a bus name becomes a CANBus.

    A cap on how long boot may spend on CAN device configuration that is not working.

    Limelight
    Provides a high-level interface to a single Limelight camera for AprilTag-based pose estimation and basic targeting.

    Configuration for a single Limelight camera, including its network-table name and physical mounting position on the robot.

    Represents hardware statistics from the Limelight.

    LogStorage
    Where the robot's logs go on SystemCore, and keeping them from filling its storage.
    Main
    Do NOT add any static variables to this class, or any initialization at all.
    Mechanism
    Abstract base class representing a CTRE TalonFX-driven robot mechanism with common control modes, telemetry, and convenience Command factories.
    Mechanism.Config
    Configuration for a Mechanism, encapsulating the TalonFX hardware configuration, control request objects, and mechanism-level parameters (gear ratio, soft limits, PID/FF gains, Motion Magic profile, current limits, etc.).
    Mechanism.FollowerConfig
    Configuration for a TalonFX follower motor that mirrors the leader.
    MotorInputs
    Everything a Mechanism reads from its motors in one loop, as an AdvantageKit input.
    Mount
    Represents a simulation component that other mechanisms can be attached to.
    Mount.MountType
    Discriminates between the two supported mount types so child mechanisms can apply the correct positioning logic.
    Mountable
    Mixin interface for simulation components that can be attached to a Mount.

    ShotCalculator
     
    ShotCalculator.SetShot
    The fixed shots, one per parking spot, from the offseason bot's set shots (463c465, fa1376b) less its hub-face shot, which FM cannot make.
    ShotCalculator.ShootingParameters
    Immutable snapshot of all quantities needed to command the drive, hood, and flywheel subsystems for a single shot.
    ShotGate
    Decides, once per loop, whether fuel may be fed into the flywheel.
    ShotGate.Blocker
    Why the feed is being held, or ShotGate.Blocker.NONE.
    ShotGate.Decision
    The gate's answer for one loop.
    ShotGate.FeedReason
    Why fuel is (or is not) going in.
    ShotGate.Inputs
    One loop's view of the shot, every field from a logged input or something computed from one.
    ShotGate.Tolerances
    Gate tolerances.
    ShotLog
    One row per volley, under ShotLog/: what was aimed, and what the mechanisms were doing, on the loop the feed opened.
    ShotLog.Shot
    Everything a row needs that the log cannot look up itself.
    SimLoop
    Shared high-frequency simulation loop.
    SimMotor
    Shared wiring between a TalonFX and the WPILib physics sims in this package.
    SimScript
    A scripted drive for the desktop simulation, so the localization testbed can be exercised (and checked) without a driver: sit disabled so the Limelights seed the pose, then drive a lap of straights, strafes and spins in teleop while every pose source is logged.
    SimScript.Actions
    The script's two non-driver actions, as an AdvantageKit input so a replay of a scripted run performs them on the same loop (the driving itself is already replayed, through the logged Driver Station).
    SimVision
    Simulated cameras for every pose source, on PhotonLib's VisionSystemSim.
    SimVision.LimelightSimCamera
    One simulated Limelight: PhotonLib results read once per loop, shared by MT1 and MT2.
    SimVision.LimelightSimIO
    A Limelight source backed by a PhotonLib sim camera.
    SimVision.QuestSimIO
    Simulated QuestNav: reports truth in its own frame, which lines up with the field only after SimVision.QuestSimIO.resetPose(Pose2d), plus a random-walk drift.
    SpectrumCANcoder
    Wraps a CTRE CANcoder and applies Spectrum-specific configuration.
    SpectrumCANcoder.CANCoderFeedbackType
    Selects how the TalonFX reads position data from the remote CANcoder.
    SpectrumCANcoderConfig
    Configuration parameters for a SpectrumCANcoder.
    SpectrumLEDs
    CANdle-based addressable LED subsystem that wraps a CTRE CANdle and exposes a rich library of pattern factories (solid, stripe, blink, breathe, rainbow, chase, bounce, gradient, ombre, wave, countdown, etc.).
    SpectrumLEDs.CANdlePattern
    Functional interface for a LED pattern that drives a segment of a CANdle strip.
    SpectrumLEDs.Config
    Configuration for a SpectrumLEDs subsystem instance.
    SpectrumRobot
    Base robot class for Spectrum robots on SystemCore: AdvantageKit's LoggedRobot, which runs the loop, records every input, and drives replay.
    SpectrumState
    Represents a global or subsystem-specific state that can be used as a Trigger.
    StdDevModel
    Chooses how much the estimator should trust an observation that has passed every gate.
    StdDevModel.StdDevs
    Standard deviations handed to the pose estimator.
